about: scripts/lanework/lanework.sh: a lane hands its branch back to the main checkout whatever push guard work put on its remotes. Each mutant restores one way push failed (2026-11-19) and a test of this package kills it. The lanework-env and lanework-cache rows: every lane shares one Go cache that no clone or snapshot copies (SHARED-GOCACHE, 2026-11-22).

mutants.name: lanework-push-by-remote
mutants.rule: push reaches the main checkout by its path, so work's guard on the main-checkout remote does not stop it.

mutants.name: lanework-create-keeps-guard
mutants.rule: A lane create makes guards origin only; main-checkout, its push remote, takes a plain git push.

mutants.name: lanework-env-per-lane
mutants.rule: Every lane's env names the one shared Go cache, not a cache of its own.

mutants.name: lanework-cache-relative
mutants.from: *) fail "the shared Go cache is not an absolute path: '$SHARED_CACHE'" ;;
mutants.rule: The shared Go cache is an absolute path.

mutants.name: lanework-cache-dots
mutants.rule: The shared Go cache has no . or .. part, which would hide that it lies inside a base.

mutants.name: lanework-cache-in-base
mutants.rule: The shared Go cache is not inside the source base, which every lane clones.

mutants.name: lanework-cache-in-storage
mutants.rule: The shared Go cache is not inside the base's workspace storage.

mutants.name: lanework-trim-unbounded
mutants.rule: The trim deletes nothing while the shared cache is under its bound.

mutants.name: lanework-trim-never
mutants.from:
# A cache a clone would copy is refused before any lane is made.
  cache=$(lane_gocache)
  trim_gocache "$cache"
mutants.to:
# A cache a clone would copy is refused before any lane is made.
  cache=$(lane_gocache)
mutants.rule: A lane create bounds the shared cache: Go's own trim bounds it by age only.

mutants.name: lanework-trim-recent
mutants.rule: The trim never deletes an entry used within two hours, which a running build may hold (Go marks use at most hourly).

mutants.name: lanework-trim-anything
mutants.rule: The trim deletes only the cache's entries, never its own files beside them (trim.txt, README).

mutants.name: lanework-env-no-go-path
mutants.rule: A lane's env puts the source's Go first on PATH.

mutants.name: lanework-go-bin-ignores-gomod
mutants.rule: The lane's Go is the one go.mod's toolchain line names, not its go line.

mutants.name: lanework-go-bin-override-ignored
mutants.rule: LANE_GO_BIN names the lane's Go when it is set.

mutants.name: lanework-env-no-goroot
mutants.rule: A lane's env states GOROOT, the lane's Go's, which a -trimpath build lacks.

mutants.name: lanework-trial-no-drivers
mutants.rule: trial merges with the merge drivers the attributes name, read from the clone or the attributes' driver table and passed by -c, so a clone without them trials as work merges.

mutants.name: lanework-drivers-write-none
mutants.rule: drivers writes each merge driver the clone's attributes name and its configuration lacks.

mutants.name: lanework-drivers-skip-work
mutants.rule: drivers asks work first (work doctor -here -fix), so work's own table writes the drivers; the header's table fills only what work left. Not run: crunch.
